instrumentation.accounting_equation: For ideal clocks: W=C+S; T=C+B; W-T=S-B. B is extra on-CPU work in the outer thread-clock bracket. Recorded values add unmeasured clock error. Thus W-T is not S.
instrumentation.error_bound: No same-scope bracketing overhead, actual clock resolution/error budget or scheduler trace was captured. No numerical upper bound on B or clock error is inferred from residuals alone.
instrumentation.profile_warning: Only native AA binary clocks used. Profile binary includes sample_start/stop and symbolization in the outer thread bracket; do not pool its W-T with native rows.

conditional_next_design.order: w0,t0,w1 / unchanged body / w2,t1,w3; CPU/QoS observations outside w0..w3
conditional_next_design.ideal_bounds: Assuming monotonic accurate wall reads, reliable CPU accounting and sample instants within call brackets: boundaryCPU B in[0,M]; innerCPU C in[max(0,T-M),min(T,I)]; offCPU S in[I-T,I-T+M] intersect[0,I].
conditional_next_design.block_rule: Sum each row lower/upper innerCPU bounds by ABBA side. Positive-denominator ratio interval is [C_B_lower/C_A_upper-1,C_B_upper/C_A_lower-1]. A wholly outside +/-1% interval conditionally excludes descheduling-only stable-work explanation; overlap is inconclusive, never proof. Apply separately to every block with all rows retained.
conditional_next_design.limits: Read-completion latency is included by outer wall brackets, but timestamp quantization/accuracy and thread accounting lag need explicit conservative error terms. clock_getres is nominal resolution, not an accuracy/lag bound; empty controls do not prove a worst-case workload bound. Boundary preemption widens M and makes a result inconclusive; never discard it.
conditional_next_design.feasibility: Concrete narrower instrumentation-validity diagnostic, materially different from repeating EXP009 counts/warmups. Requires separately published harness, actual codegen ordering checks, controlled empty/workload fixtures, predeclared uncertainty/inconclusive gates and independent review before any native authorization.
